text: Can you pull together every ticket number on Quarrendon Freight Lines you can find across Moss's notes? List each with where it comes from. Putting it in the weekly notes.
reply_text:
I've replied to Dana in their DM. Moss's notes mention two ticket numbers for Quarrendon Freight Lines:

- **#4419**, from Moss's undated North cheat sheet (`teams/team-north/digests/north-account-cheatsheet.md`). Gatehouse barcode scanners weren't reading trailer tags at Door 14 on third shift, and it was escalated to tier-2.
- **#PD-4492**, from Moss's 5 Oct 2025 Sunday prep (`teams/team-north/digests/2025-10-05-north-sunday.md`). Eau Claire kiosk check-ins weren't sending SMS bay assignments, and support patched it on 4 Oct.

I also told Dana about two things before the list goes into the weekly notes:

- **#4419 has two different descriptions.** Marcus's own 14 Jul 2025 note gives the same number for QFL but calls it "Gate 3 printer lag." One of the two is probably wrong, so I suggested checking with Marcus or support.
- **Two tickets left out on purpose.** Moss's Central handoffs note mentions #4409 and #4412, but they're on Pree's dealer account, not QFL.

Everything I used was in public team digests and notes Dana can open themselves. GBrain was running keyword-only search, so I read each of Moss's six notes directly to check the list. No finance figures were involved, and nothing needed approval.
